Title: Yoana Karageorgieva
Description: I study Journalism and Mass Communication and Political Science and International Relations at the American University in Bulgaria, with exchange semesters at the University of Maine and the University of Limerick. I mostly tell stories through video: short documentaries, reels and student news, alongside written articles.

Title: Landscape photo behind the intro
Ivan in the Sky
Description: A short profile documentary featuring retired pilot Ivan Nedyalkov, who spent a lifetime traversing the globe behind the controls of commercial aircraft, his last position as a pilot being for Emirates. Now retired, he guides aspiring pilots and aviation enthusiasts through motivational flights and flight courses, passing on his lifelong passion for aviation.

Title: First Breath
Description: An intimate profile of Anna-Maria Yurochka, a dedicated neonatology nurse at Pulse Hospital in Blagoevgrad, Bulgaria. The video captures the delicate reality of her daily work and tells the story of how she chose a life devoted to bringing new life into the world.

Title: This is what they answered
Description: Five individuals across different generations are asked a singular question: What do you see when you look in the mirror? Moving chronologically from the oldest to the youngest, this short documentary reflects on how our connection to our own reflection transforms as time passes, proving that every face carries a world of untold stories.

Title: Yana and the war in Ukraine
Description: This documentary explores the story of Yana, a Ukrainian student from Kharkiv who was 21 when this video was filmed in 2024. It offers an intimate look into how she survives amidst the ongoing war between Russia and Ukraine, courageously continuing her university education while dealing with the daily terror of conflict.

Title: Reels for Diversoviel
Description: In May and June 2025, I collaborated with three fellow students from the American University in Bulgaria to produce short-form video reels for Diversoviel, a women's immigrant center in Vienna, Austria. Co-founded by Haifa and Stefanie, the center serves as an essential safe space and community hub that empowers immigrant women to build a home in Austria. Our content captured the heart of the center's vibrant workshops and activities. This opportunity was made possible through the Vienna summer program led by AUBG professors Kiril Kirkov and Rossen Petrov.

Title: The Maine Journal
Description: During my Spring 2026 exchange semester at the University of Maine in Orono, I was hired to work for The Maine Journal under ASAP Media Services, a division of VEMI Lab, and continued through the summer in a team with other students. Under the supervision of our mentor Grant Beals, we produced digital news content on campus news, student life, Maine's nature and wildlife on campus, student achievements and university events.

Title: DeWired
Description: During the Fall 2025 semester of my third year at the American University in Bulgaria, my colleagues and I from Professor Darina Sarelska's TV Studio course co-founded DeWired, an independent student news outlet. As a reporter, videographer, anchor and associate producer, I helped bring stories to life through monthly news broadcasts on YouTube, with short-form coverage for Instagram.
